title: Elizondo's book: blocked from a Lockheed program

tellings.quote: Lando's book he specifically mentions how you know they went to locky M to see if they could you know get inside this program

plain: According to Michels, the book by Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, describes how Elizondo and his colleagues went to Lockheed Martin, the large American defense company, to try to get inside a secret program there, and were kept out. Michels brings it up from Elizondo's book during a conversation with another guest, giving no further detail of what the program was.
